'''Ofar Tan-Doov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ofar Tan-Doov had been [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before achieving the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During his service to the Order, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched Tan-Doov to [[Romin]], a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] stricken with a grievous social class division. His mission was to locate and topple the regime of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], but he was sidetracked when he encountered the Force-sensitive twins [[Eldewn Sarvool|Eldewn]] and [[Elsae Sarvool]]. After convincing their parents to allow the twins to be taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for induction into the Order, Tan-Doov sent a preliminary report back to the Temple warning the High Council that he believed that the twins' power could become dangerous should they not receive proper training.<ref name="WOC" />

Unable to finish his original mission, Tan-Doov loaded the twins aboard his ship and set coordinates back to Coruscant. During take-off, the ship was damaged when a concealed [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], installed by the crime lord the Jedi had once sought, exploded. Tan-Doov did not survive the explosion and the following crash, though the Sarvool twins did. Escaping the wreckage, they set out into the Romin undercity, hating both the Jedi and the crime lord who was responsible for altering their lives so drastically.<ref name="WOC" />
